GOVERNMENT OF GUJARAT 
General Administration Department 
Resolution No: CEL/102009/881985/GH, 
Sachivalaya, Gandhinagar. 
Dated the 15th October, 2015. 
 
 
RESOLUTION 
 
 
 
 
The Government of Gujarat vide letter No. CEL/102009/881985/GH, dated            
16-07-2015 had invited fresh bids from the Mobile Phone Service Providers for the mobile 
phones in Government use.  After careful consideration of the bids received from the service 
providers, the offer of M/s. Vodafone West Limited, Ahmedabad was accepted and an 
agreement was entered into with the said company on 30th September, 2015.    
 
2.

with effect from 1st October, 2015 and in supersession to this department’s Resolution of 
even number dated 28-12-2010 shall be as follows:

blocks.text:
2. In case of termination, the service provider shall continue to provide services till the
alternate arrangements are made.

3. 1116 tariff as mentioned above shall be applicable to the mobile phones sanctioned by
the State Government. However, prior sanction from the State Government shall be
necessary for the ISD and International Roaming Facility, if required.

4. Service provider shall provide unique series, in which first five digits will remain
common for all Government of Gujarat Mobile Phone numbers.

5. Closed User Group : All the connections obtained through Government of Gujarat will
be in closed user group (C.U.G.).

6. Customer Care and Helpline : Service Provider will nominate a Nodal Officer or

customer care and Helpline facilities, which would be available 24 hours during the
period of entire agreement.

7. Joint Secretary (Protocol), General Administration Department will be the authorized

officer from Govt. of Gujarat to monitor the Mobile Phone connections and change in
status of Mobile Phone Services.

M/s. Vodafone West Ltd. will give month wise statement of bill amount with the break-
up of rental + call charges + charges for value added services for each Government
Mobile Phone Number to Joint Secretary (Protocol), General Administration Department
regularly during the entire contract period of the agreement.

9. Booster Pack, if any given to any Government SIM card holder, shall be carried forward
to the next month without the constraint of billing cycle.

10. For Booster Pack’‘s Data, if any remains unused during the billing cycle, shall be carried
forward to the next month without the constraint of the billing cycle.

11. The service provider should extend the tariff plan as finalized to the Boards Vi

Corporations, owned and controlled by Government of Gujarat and include their mobile
phone connections in the CUG without additional charges.

12. Joint Secretary (Protocol), General Administration Department will provide the name,
designation and address of the recipient officers / employees to M/s. Vodafone and
based on this M/s. Vodafone West Lt. will activate the Mobile SIM immediately.

13. For any service related help / issue, the contact persons from M/s. Vodafone West Ltd.

will be (1) Shri Gautam Chauhan (Mobile No. 9825000035) and (2) Shri Dennis
Tharakkan (Mobile No. 9825000221).

14. The charges for VAS, Premium SMS, Caller Tune,

etc. facilities shall be borne by the
concerned officer personally.

15. In case of any dispute, document of the agreement dated 30-09-2015 shall prevail.

By order and in the name of the Governor of Gujarat,

( Jwalant Trivedi )
Joint Secretary (Protocol)
General Administration Department

Government of Gujarat
To,

M/s. Vodafone West Ltd.,
Vodafone House, Corporate Road, Prahladnagar, Off. S.G.Highway, Ahmedabad.

3/4
